description: Search the individual slides inside PPT Depot's templates by keyword (slide title, overview text, tags, and parent template name). Each result includes the slide's public page URL, its preview image URL, a short overview, tags, and the parent template. Optional filters: tag_id (from list_tags) and template_id. Use get_slide for the full description of a slide (overview, why it matters, how to use it).

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "SWOT", "issue tree", "stakeholder map", "pricing waterfall".

tag_id.description: Optional tag slug filter, e.g. "strategic-planning" (see list_tags).

template_id.description: Optional template slug filter, e.g. "business-case" (see search_templates).

name: search_slides
title: Search Individual Slides
